verdict.rationale: Both changes fix the bug the same way: skip lines that are blank or whitespace-only before parsing, keeping the original line numbering. A also updates the README, whose CSV section says that any unreadable line stops the import, so the documentation now matches the new behavior. B leaves that sentence stale and wraps a one-line check in a trivial `_is_blank` helper. B's tests cover a few more edge cases (tab, empty string, the trailing-line case on its own), but that does not outweigh the documentation gap.

b_issues: README still says any line that cannot be read stops the import, which no longer matches the behavior
